summary.intent: Run the GSD manager to complete phases 42–44 of CipherBox v1.1 (API unpin integrity, FUSE write durability, IPNS conflict handling) — three gap-closure phases identified in a UAT audit — including inline discuss, plan with --auto, and full wave-based execution for all three phases.
summary.outcome: All three phases executed successfully and merged into their feature branches; v1.1 milestone is complete with 29/29 phases done. Phase 42 fixed a cross-tenant unpin vulnerability, Phase 43 added a persist-backed write journal for FUSE crash durability, and Phase 44 wired three-way merge + CAS retry for IPNS conflicts across all TS callers.

repo: The Kubo node runs with the `server` profile and swarm port 4001 publicly exposed (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72): the server profile only disables local-network discovery, keeping full DHT participation, meaning every pinned CID broadcasts a provider record to public crawlers.

The unpin endpoint (`POST /ipfs/unpin`) is behind JwtAuthGuard only with open signup — it never reads req.user before passing the CID to Kubo, making any authenticated account capable of unpinning any CID they know.

Writable-share saves drop `prunedCids` without calling unpin (shared-write.ts:450) — there is no legitimate cross-user unpin path today, making any no-row hit at the server layer inherently suspicious.
BYO-IPFS unpin is broken in both directions (advisory rows counted but provider.unpin never called client-side); the server-side guardedUnpin fix handles it for free since 'not pinned' is swallowed.

`.prettierignore` was missing from the repo; prettier was mangling `.planning/` markdown tables and `.claude/` JS files. Created with exclusions for `.planning/`, `.claude/agents/gsd-*.md`, `.claude/commands/gsd/`, `.claude/gsd-core/`, and related GSD-controlled paths.
GSD auto-manages per-phase `feat/` branches; planning commits land on the phase branch, not main. Main and origin/main remain untouched throughout.
gsd commit helper returns `"committed": false` as a false negative even when the commit landed — always verify with `git log`, never blind-retry.

Phase 43 WinFsp cross-compilation (`cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp`) fails on macOS due to pre-existing cross-compilation failures in `windows-future` and `winfsp-sys` — unrelated to phase changes; `cargo check` for winfsp-feature crates is the correct gate on macOS.

After any Rust or TS source change that updates a package depended upon by another, the downstream dist must be rebuilt before typechecks — stale dists cause false type errors (happened for both `@cipherbox/sdk` and `@cipherbox/sdk-core` post-wave merges).
The `_auto_chain_active` key in GSD `config.json` is ephemeral and must be reset to `false` at end of chain to prevent unwanted auto-advance in the next session.

code.finding: Unpin handler never reads req.user — passes raw CID string directly to Kubo pin/rm. The guardedUnpin delegation fix (Phase 42, plan 42-05) rewires this to vaultService.guardedUnpin(req.user.id, dto.cid).
Upload-compensation path calls a global pin/rm on a CID that content-addressed dedup may share with another user — rerouted through guardedUnpin in 42-05 with a D-13 race-window comment.

Kubo v0.40 runs with `server` profile and swarm port 4001 tcp+udp publicly exposed. Server profile ≠ no DHT — it only disables local-network peer discovery; public DHT participation remains, broadcasting provider records for all pinned CIDs.

Writable-share saves drop prunedCids (version pruning) without calling unpin — no cross-user unpin exists in the legitimate write-share flow. Also updated in Phase 44 to consume the new file CAS return shape and pass baseChildren for three-way merge.

Phase 44 rewired this to use new updateFileMetadata CAS contract from @cipherbox/sdk-core (drops redundant replaceFileInFolder call, adds maxVersionsPerFile from vault store, adds baseChildren: parentFolder.children, logs isConflictExhausted).

Phase 43 plan 43-01 rewrote this file entirely: JournalOp enum, JournalEntryStatus, JournalEntry struct, WriteQueue with put/remove/load_all_for_vault/update_status/record_failure/ordered_for_replay. The old implementation had no persist-back durability.

Post-gap-closure: a spawn_journal.remove() call remained in the Windows upload background thread (CR-08 mirror missed by plan 43-07). Fixed inline after re-verification — removal must be gated on per-file IPNS publish success, not unconditional.

Phase 44 added 4-attempt merge loop with baseChildren param and backoff constants. updateFolderMetadataAndPublish now returns publishedChildren (the exact merged set at successful publish) so the next write composes from the correct base.

workflow: worktree cleanup-wave is NOT idempotent: re-running after a partial merge causes already-merged entries to report `branch_mismatch` and abort the whole run. Workaround: write a reduced manifest containing only remaining unmerged entries.
cleanup-wave must be run from the repo root — running it with cwd inside an agent worktree causes a false `base_mismatch` because the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd.

`pnpm --filter @pkg test -- --testPathPattern=X` breaks silently: pnpm inserts `--` as a separator so jest receives the pattern as a positional argument (a regex), not a flag. Use `pnpm --filter @pkg exec jest --testPathPattern='X'` instead.

When a merge leaves MERGE_HEAD after conflict auto-resolution but the commit step fails, `git commit --no-edit` concludes it cleanly — avoid `git merge --abort` unless the merge is genuinely unwanted.

`nest build` as a side-effect generates formatting-only drift in openapi.json (500+ lines). Restore with `git checkout -- packages/api-client/openapi.json` before merging worktrees that ran api:generate.

1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true` on all git commit Bash calls; signing failures ('agent returned an error') require restarting the 1Password desktop app. Never use `--no-gpg-sign` as a workaround.

Worktree executors leave `node_modules` symlinks and `.husky/_` dirs untracked — these block cleanup-wave. Add explicit cleanup (rm node_modules/.husky) before running cleanup-wave, or instruct executors to clean up in their plan.

Cross-package TS typechecks always require rebuilding intermediate dists after source changes (tsc -p packages/sdk-core; tsc -p packages/sdk) before running the downstream check. Stale dists produce false errors indistinguishable from real adoption gaps.
The `zsh multi-glob rm abort` issue: `rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules` fails entirely if any glob matches nothing. Always use explicit single paths per rm call.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures mid-session required restarting the desktop app; multiple plan/commit cycles were blocked waiting for recovery.
Session quota exhausted three times during execution, requiring mid-task interruptions and manual resume prompts.
gsd commit helper returned false-negative `"committed": false` multiple times when commits actually landed — wasted verification cycles and nearly triggered duplicate commits.
worktree cleanup-wave is not idempotent: partially merged manifests had to be manually reduced to remaining entries on each retry.
pnpm test flag forwarding silently breaks jest testPathPattern — this caused confusing 'no tests found' failures before the direct jest invocation workaround was established.
openapi.json formatting drift from `nest build` side effects had to be manually restored before each worktree merge.
42-05 merge left a MERGE_HEAD state (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed) — required `git commit --no-edit` to finalize, then manual worktree remove + branch -D.
prettier mangled the VALIDATION.md regex testPathPattern table row (split pipe into a table column) before .prettierignore existed — found only during plan-checker gate.
Planner agent hit a socket error mid-session after writing plans 01-03, requiring filesystem verification and a continuation agent for plans 04-08.
Cross-package dist staleness caused 8 false web typecheck errors post-gap-wave merge — required rebuilding sdk and sdk-core dists before the errors were diagnosed as non-real.
User feedback: assistant re-presented action menus instead of answering the user's direct questions about unpin attack surface — had to be explicitly corrected to answer in plain prose first.
open_items: Phase 42: SECURITY.md missing — `/gsd-secure-phase 42` was flagged but not run; the security alert Grafana rule is provisioned but the security audit artifact is absent.

Phase 43: Four runtime UAT items require manual human testing on physical hardware (FUSE journal fsync recovery, WinFsp path, macOS crash recovery, tray WriteParked notification) — documented in 43-UAT.md.
Phase 43: Pending-uploads UI (show parked writes count + notify on park) deferred as a future improvement — noted in CONTEXT.md but out of scope for this phase.
Phase 42: BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring deferred — server-side guardedUnpin handles BYO advisory rows correctly, but the client SDK never calls provider.unpin on delete.
Phase 42: Writable-share prunedCids leak — share recipients' usage quota is not reconciled when versions are pruned; deferred to a future phase.
Phase 44: Rust FUSE merge parity deferred (D-09) — TS callers have three-way merge, but the Rust FUSE crate publish path does not; flagged for a future phase.
REQUIREMENTS.md traceability warning (phase 42 plan-checker noted a gap) — pre-existing issue not introduced by these phases, requires investigation.

Phase 42 todos closure: the two source todos were moved to completed/ but they lacked `resolves_phase` tags so auto-close was skipped — the manual move pattern should be documented for future phases without that tag.
